name: Motega Firemane
summary: At Whitereach Post, Motega Firemane studies the beasts of Thousand Needles. A serpent spirit’s vengeance and his young assistant’s mishaps keep drawing him from his work.

sections.title: Scholar of the Canyons
sections.body: Motega Firemane came south to Thousand Needles four years after the Third War. He studies the beasts that survive among its towering mesas. His young assistant, Pao'ka Swiftmountain, came with him, though Pao'ka’s protective father had been reluctant to let him leave Mulgore. Motega made camp at Whitereach Post with Kanati Greycloud. He hoped to observe nature in peace, but dangers on the canyon floor often force him to fight for survival.

sections.title: The Wrath of Arikara
sections.body:
Word from Freewind Post brought news that Arikara had returned to the canyons. The fearsome winged serpent spirit sought vengeance against Cairne Bloodhoof. Motega could not understand the spirit’s grudge against the High Chieftain, but moved quickly to protect the Horde.

He sent scouts to gather Incendia agave from the canyon basin and carry it to Elder Magatha Grimtotem in Thunder Bluff. She enchanted the plant into sacred powder. Hunters used it to summon and slay Arikara, then brought the serpent’s hide back to Whitereach Post as proof that Cairne was safe.

sections.title: Guardian of Whitereach
sections.body: Galak centaur near Whitereach Post kept probing the camp. They even plotted to assassinate Kanati Greycloud and his followers. Then young Pao'ka wandered away from the campfire and disappeared into the wyvern-filled heights of Highperch. Motega was frustrated by the young brave’s carelessness, but relieved when Horde travelers brought him back alive.

faq.answer: Motega Firemane studies the wildlife of Thousand Needles from Whitereach Post. He came to the canyons with other braves and his assistant, Pao'ka Swiftmountain.

faq.q: Where can Motega Firemane be found?
faq.answer: You can find Motega Firemane at Whitereach Post, a small Horde campsite on the road in northwestern Thousand Needles near Camp E'thok.

faq.q: Why is Motega concerned about Arikara?
faq.answer: Arikara is a vengeful serpent spirit who appeared in Thousand Needles to target Cairne Bloodhoof. Motega does not understand the spirit’s grudge, but takes the threat seriously and directs hunters to summon and slay it.

faq.q: What role does Magatha Grimtotem play in Motega's plans?
faq.answer: Motega sends scouts to gather Incendia agave and carry it to Magatha Grimtotem on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Magatha enchants the plant into sacred powder that can summon Arikara.

faq.q: What happened to Motega's companion, Pao'ka?
faq.answer: Pao'ka Swiftmountain wandered into the dangerous wyvern roosts of Highperch and became lost. Motega feared for him, especially since Pao'ka’s father had been reluctant to let him make the journey. Travelers brought him safely back to Whitereach Post.

faq.q: What other dangers does Whitereach Post face?
faq.answer: The nearby Galak centaur threaten Whitereach Post with ambushes and plots to assassinate Kanati Greycloud and the other tauren there. Rogue spirits and predators also threaten the camp.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can see Motega’s work at a research camp in Kalimdor’s wilds. He also helps protect Cairne Bloodhoof from spiritual threats.
As a tauren, you share Motega’s respect for nature and devotion to Cairne Bloodhoof. He studies the Earth Mother’s creatures and defends his tribe from ancient spirits.
As a hunter, you share Motega’s reliance on skilled trackers. They gather canyon plants, follow wyverns in Highperch, and track the mighty spirit Arikara.
